title: Eject! Eject!
caption: Eject! Eject! (V)
lore: The Guidenhouser ejection seat has saved many pilots from their exploding starships. However, system malfunctions have sometimes caused spontaneous ejection.
game_text: Deploy on opponent’s starfighter with a permanent pilot. Starfighter’s game text (except related to identity and ability of permanent pilot, and capacity) is suspended and it is forfeit +5. {alter}
